VALIDATION_ERROR: Some fields are invalid. Check the form and try again.
CONFLICT: This conflicts with something that already exists.
FORBIDDEN: You don't have access to that.
RATE_LIMITED: Too many requests. Wait a moment and try again.
UPSTREAM_UNAVAILABLE: An external service is not responding. Try again shortly.
CONFIGURATION_ERROR: The server is missing some configuration.
INTERNAL_ERROR: Something went wrong on our side.
NETWORK_ERROR: Can't reach the server. Check your connection.
EMAIL_TAKEN: An account with this email already exists.
PASSWORD_TOO_WEAK: Use at least 8 characters for your password.
TOKEN_INVALID: Your session has expired. Please sign in again.
LLM_NOT_CONFIGURED: No AI provider is set up yet. Add a free Groq or Gemini key on the server.
LLM_UNAVAILABLE: The AI providers could not complete this request. Try again.
LLM_BUDGET_EXHAUSTED: Today's free AI quota is used up. It resets at midnight UTC.
FILE_INVALID: That file type isn't supported. Upload a PDF, DOCX or TXT.
FILE_NOT_FOUND: The file could not be found.
RESUME_TEXT_EMPTY: No readable text was found. Scanned PDFs aren't supported yet.
RESUME_TOO_LONG: This resume is too long to process.
RESUME_LIMIT_REACHED: You've reached the maximum number of resumes.
RESUME_NOT_PARSED: Upload a resume and wait for it to be read first.
RESUME_PARSE_IN_PROGRESS: This resume is still being read.
RESUME_HAS_EDITS: Reading the file again will replace your corrections.
PROFILE_INCOMPLETE: Add at least one target job title to your profile first.
JOB_SCORING_IN_PROGRESS: This job is already being scored.
DISCOVERY_TOO_SOON: A search ran recently. Try again in a few minutes.
APPLICATION_CHANGED: This changed in the meantime. Reload and try again.
INVALID_STATUS_TRANSITION: That action isn't available right now.
TAILOR_IN_PROGRESS: A tailored resume is already being prepared.
VARIANT_NOT_FOUND: The tailored resume is no longer current.
RESUME_TAILOR_FACT_VIOLATION: Fix the flagged statements before approving. Add genuinely new facts to your master resume.
RESUME_VARIANT_NOT_APPROVED: Approve the tailored resume for this job first.
HIRING_QUERY_INVALID: The search query template is invalid.
CONTACT_DO_NOT_CONTACT: This person asked not to be contacted.
GMAIL_NOT_CONFIGURED: Gmail sign-in isn't set up on this server. Use SMTP instead.
OAUTH_STATE_INVALID: The sign-in link expired. Start again.
MAIL_NOT_CONNECTED: Connect Gmail or SMTP before sending email.
MAIL_AUTH_EXPIRED: Your mailbox connection expired. Reconnect it.
TEMPLATE_INVALID: The template uses an unknown placeholder.
OUTREACH_NOT_EDITABLE: This email can no longer be changed.
OUTREACH_DUPLICATE: You already emailed this person about this job.
PORTAL_UNSUPPORTED: Sessions are only used for LinkedIn.
